utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on it, but I’ve heard it’s moving along with volunteers and supplies coming in. Do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not totally sure yet — I asked Hana to confirm the start time and tool list, since I’ll probably be late again. If you hear what supplies are still short, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will — I’m waiting on Jules for the needs list, and I’ll pass along anything solid once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, we’re aiming for Saturday late morning into early afternoon for the repair drive, and I’m lining up table setup plus a couple more repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll note Saturday late morning into early afternoon and keep Sam on pickup tracking while I hold Jules as flexible help once the stations are set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you, Opal — keeping Sam on pickups and Jules flexible will really help once I confirm the table setup and extra repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll bring over whatever tools or help you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on Leo for the address and list, but once I’ve got it straight I’ll give you a shout.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — once you’ve got it, just send me the list and I’ll see what tools I can bring over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Rey — thanks. When you get here, I’ll point you to the stuff that still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll come by and help keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. If you remind me when you get here, I’ll try not to forget what we’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, I’m still checking the supply closet, but we’re focusing first on safety repairs like railings, lighting, and leaks for the community room table this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo—can you confirm whether it’s definitely this Saturday, and if safety repair supplies are the only things we’re accepting for now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s planned for this weekend, but I don’t want to call Saturday definite until Rosa and I confirm the time. For now, yes—please have folks focus on safety repair supplies first, and I’ll share the final tool list once I finish the closet count.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Ira! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s helping with setup and volunteers, and I’d love for you to come or pass a flyer along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass a flyer along while I’m out and keep an ear open for any more help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep handing flyers out around the block, and hopefully we’ll get a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll send you the address and the short list for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I just hope there’s enough room and the tables are all set before everyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check on the tables and make sure there’s space before people show up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, the repair drive’s coming along well — Opal’s sorting stations, and I’ve offered to help wherever they need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for pitching in. I’ll double-check the start time and what tools to bring so everything’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — once you’ve got the time and tool list, I can pass it along to Nell and anyone else who’s trying to get oriented.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — I’m pulling the repair drive list together now, and I’d love your help. What’s broken, and when would you be free to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the repair drive, but I can help once I know what’s needed. Tell me what’s broken, and I’ll check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — let’s start with the broken items, and then I’ll match them to what we need. If you can also send me your free times, I’ll slot you in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Uli, I was just going to ask around about the repair drive—sounds like they may need extra folding tables or tool kits if folks bring half the neighborhood’s broken lamps and toasters.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe I can help pass that along. I’m not sure I can haul tables, but I can ask if anyone has tool kits to lend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Uli—thanks! I’ll keep asking around too, and maybe we can round up a few kits before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a date yet, and what repairs still need attention?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m aiming for Saturday the 18th, from nine to noon. I’m still confirming the list, but so far it’s loose steps, a couple of fence boards, and some leaky hose fittings.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Saturday the 18th, nine to noon. Do you already have Sam and Lila for those jobs, or should I ask one more person to cover the hose fittings?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, what do you need from me for the repair drive? I can help, just keep me to the main details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — just send me the list of homes and which ones still need a pickup versus which are already covered, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the homes list and I’ll mark which ones still need a pickup and which are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Kira! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s helping with setup and volunteers, and I’d love for you to come or pass a flyer along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Quinn—but before I pass anything along, can you confirm it’s definitely this Saturday and what items they’re actually accepting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it’s definitely this Saturday, and they’re taking small household items like lamps, toasters, clothes with simple mends, and bikes—nothing hazardous or too big to carry.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still need help with the fence, a leaky gutter, and the broken front step. Sam and Lila are in, and I’m still trying to line up one more person.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — fence, leaky gutter, and the broken front step, with one more helper still needed. Once you confirm the time, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll confirm the time as soon as I have it and let you know. Appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m putting together a simple list first, so we can keep the repair drive organized. Once it’s ready, I’ll let you know exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Eli — thanks for keeping it organized. I’ll wait for the list and help however I can once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll have the list ready soon, and then we can match folks to the jobs without any confusion.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course, Faye — I’ll double-check the repair drive start time and the tools list before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — that really helps. Once you have the start time, let me know and I can plan around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll confirm the start time first and let you know right away so you can work it around drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo, I’m still catching up on the repair drive—Jules mentioned volunteers and supplies are coming together, but do you know the latest on dates or what repairs they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still double-checking that myself — I’ve got Saturday and the accepted items on my list, and I’ll pass along the real details once I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — that would be great. I’ll hold off on telling anyone Saturday or the repair list until you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — we’ve got a few volunteers and some tools and supplies already coming in. If you want, I can fill you in on what still needs to be covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please—what still needs to be covered? I’ll probably be running late, so I want to know what I should bring when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly we still need extension cords, work gloves, labeled bins for parts, and a few basic hand tools. If you’re running late, bringing any of those when you arrive would still be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive? I was meaning to check that out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: You should, Noah, but maybe go a little early—if everyone arrives with broken lamps and chairs at once, they’ll need space to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good point, Pia—I hadn’t thought about the pile-up. I’ll try to get there early Saturday morning, assuming Leo gets me that address in time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo, I’m mapping out the repair drive pickups now—do you know which homes on your block still need help and which are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa has my porch light and back gate on the list, and I’m helping Saturday morning. I’ll check with Noah and a couple houses nearby, then send you what’s still uncovered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ll mark Rosa’s porch light and back gate as listed, and you down for Saturday morning. Send me Noah’s update and the nearby houses when you have them, and I’ll keep the pickup map current.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’ll take the flyer and pass it along if I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. If you need any more flyers or info for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Sam — thanks, I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around today and see if they still need any extra folding tables or tool kits for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess. Can you also ask if they’ve settled on a date and whether the fence, gutter, and porch step are still the main jobs?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Mina—I’ll check on the date and ask whether the fence, gutter, and porch step are still the main jobs, then I’ll pass along what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Cleo, the repair drive—right. I’m a bit fuzzy on the plan, but if you tell me what to bring, I’ll do my best not to forget it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still confirming the supply count, so I don’t have the final bring list yet. I’ll send you the time and any tools we’re short on as soon as I lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Cleo — send me the time and the short list when you have it, and I’ll keep an eye out for it. I’ll stay ready in case you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I’m happy to pitch in for the repair drive too—once Noah or Eli has the list, I can bring tools from my garage and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that’d be a big help. We’re aiming for Saturday late morning into early afternoon, so I’ll check that Noah or Eli gets the repair list to you before then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Mara — just have Noah or Eli send over the list, and I’ll bring what I can from my garage on Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
